contexts.text: A certain person who... there retained his desire to exercise command... HH 407. SE 3872.
Persuasions from self-love are characterized by wanting to exercise command over all things...
Angelic subordination is not that of command...
To want to be the greatest is to want to command others; thus he combats for command.
Command. Signified.
Sirens... are chiefly from the female sex, being those who in the bodily life... entered into everyone's affections and delights, with the end to exercise command... AC 3750:end.
Because the human race was imbued with such great self-love, and thence with the cupidity of exercising command over others from evil and falsity...
One who had died as an infant... had the disposition to exercise command over others.
Under these loves hatred against the neighbour hides itself, which is such as to want to exercise command over all...
They exercise command there relatively...

There are many of both sexes, who have been such in the bodily life, that whenever they could, they sought by art and guile to subjugate under themselves the minds of others with the end of exercising command... SE 1808, et seq. (Their arts and correspondence.)
They were so subtle, that sometimes I did not perceive that they had the intention to exercise command... The Lord, under Whom they said they wanted to exercise command, they held cheap.
They who act at the hinder part, want to exercise command.
The command is then transferred from the natural to the spiritual man.
They stir up combats, because they strive to exercise command alone, according to the maxim, divide and command...
The Hells of those who have plotted how to exercise command.
The affection of the former love flows in from Hell, which violently exercises command; but the affection of the latter love, from the Lord, Who does not exercise command, but leads.
With their lips they profess goods and truths for the sake of the lust of exercising command.
The inhabitants of Mars are not under sovereignties, but... AC 10160.
The loves of self and of the world are what have caused them from societies to become empires and kingdoms...
Empires and kingdoms are represented in Heaven as a man, and the societies in them, as the members of that man, but the king as the head.
But the subordinations in Hell are of command, and thence of ferocity; he who commands rages against those who do not favour his every order.
Then, for the sake of protection, mankind gathered themselves into kingdoms and empires... NJHD 81, References.
Especially do they do evil to each other from the cupidity of exercising command...
With the man who is not regenerate, the external or natural man exercises command... but with the man who is regenerate, the internal or spiritual man exercises command.
The most ancients did not know what it was to exercise command over others from self-love.
To want to exercise command in marriages destroys genuine love. Explained.
The end in view is what exercises command with man...
From the hereditary it is connate with everyone to want to exercise command over others.
(In that sixth Earth) they do not know what it is to exercise command and domineer; they flee at the bare idea of command, or dominion.
The governors who are such do not domineer and command, but minister and serve...
In Hell everyone wants to command others, and to be over them...
Self-love... would not only want to exercise command over the whole world, but also over Heaven, and over the Divine itself...
They said they had been in stations of great dignity in the world, and that they deserved to be above others and to command them...
The delight of raging against others, is completely conjoined with the delight of exercising command...
Those who were in the insane love of exercising command over all, appeared fiery.
Wives who aspire to command over their husbands dwell at one side of the city... DeConj 59.
Marriage love is a heavenly love, which is devoid of command.
The greatest things, in which there are degrees of both kinds, are... every empire, and every kingdom in its complex...
Preface. They have applied the Revelation to the states of empires...

There are three universal loves of which every man is moulded from creation: the love of the neighbour... the love of the world... and the love of self, which also is the love of exercising command over others...
On the sphere in the other life of those who are worldly, and desire to command others. SE 2812. SE 2820.
The Angels are such that they want to command no one.
Sirens are of two kinds; some have as an end to command man, and every society to which they can come... The other kind have not such a burning heat to exercise command...

In the other life it cannot but be that some command, and others obey; the former have contracted from the world the life of commanding, and have that sphere... While they who have served in the world have contracted the life of obeying; they know no other, and want no other; hence it is necessary to exercise command; but it must be the command of spiritual and celestial love, which thus regard others as equals, love them, and do good to them. The reverse is the case with the command of infernal and diabolical love.
They who have been strongly excited with the heat and lust of exercising command, cannot be ruled through Heaven by the Lord...
Hatred especially prevails with those who are in the love of exercising command over all; with others there is enmity.

As the human race is distinguished into empires, kingdoms, and republics, everyone is the neighbour according to the good of religion and of manners, and according to the good which he does to his country.
That to exercise command in marriages takes away marriage love.
